about: The land acknowledgement on the new-world title (title-intro.mjs), set like a film's opening card: each stanza a list of lines, shown as written. The title names the panel for screen readers; it is not shown. Pauses hold a breath after a word: which time it appears (from 1), the ms (replacing any shorter punctuation or stanza breath after it and any punctuation touching it) and, for a held word, the card rarity tier (level-tiers.mjs) whose colour it takes on once written, climbing as the poem goes. A pause with no tier is a silence only, like the long hold before Behold. A word's glow rises over glowInMs, holds for glowHoldMs of the reveal, then fades back over glowFadeMs, like a lamp passing; a word that stays keeps it once the text is whole.
title: Before this forest
stanzas: Before our forest, there was land.
Before our story, there were peoples:
and who care for them still.
of the lands beneath our homes
and beneath the machines we built.
We honour, too, the voices, old and living,
whose stories taught those machines — and us —
Behold this intricately carved wooden box,
Open the box. The path is yours.
